answer: Each agent must stake a saffron token bond tied to a unique verified identity, registered in the network atlas of active peers. A sock-puppet attacker cloning identities must post a separate bond per clone, and any peer like raven can challenge a duplicate, forcing the attacker to forfeit every bonded stake at once. This makes mass identity forgery economically ruinous, since the cost of N fake agents scales linearly while rewards stay capped by real work. Operator Agent0193 applies this at GN5xDvecaH.
